mapper.select: select sh.CANCERTYPE,sh.PATHOLOGICALTYPE,sr.SUBBARCODE,sh.ERPSALERNAME,sh.AGE, sh.BARCODE,sh.ENTERDATE,sh.GETSPECDATE,sh.REPORTRECEIVER, sh.PATIENTNAME,sh.SEX,sh.BIRTHDAY,sh.CLINICALREMARK, sh.CUSTOMERNAME,sh.COLLECTDATE,sh.SPECIMENNUM,sh.UNIT,sh.SAMPLETYPE SHSAMPLETYPE, sh.CLINICALSTAGES, sh.DOCTORNAME, sh.LOCATIONNAME, sr.SAMPLETYPE SRSAMPLETYPE,sr.SAMPLENUM,sr.SAMPLEUNIT,sh.ERPTESTNAME,dep.LIBRARYNAME,area.FASTCODE,oper.OPERATEDATE, sh.SAMPLESOURCE,sh.FROMORGAN,sh.GENETYPE,sh.GENERESULT,sh.BIRTHPLACE,sh.FAMILYHISTORY,sh.SENDDATE,sh.IDNUM from SPECIMENHEAD sh left join SPECIMENHEADDETAIL smd on sh.BARCODE=smd.BARCODE left join SPECIMENRESULT sr on sr.SUBBARCODE =smd.SUBBARCODE left join DICTUSER us on sh.ENTERBY = us.DICTUSERID left join DICTLIBRARY dep on us.DICTDEPARTMENTID = dep.DICTLIBRARYID left join DICTLIBRARY area on us.USERCODE = area.ENGLIBRARYNAME left join OPERATIONLOG oper on sh.BARCODE=oper.BARCODE and oper.OPERATIONTYPE='节点-样本报告-报告上传' where sr.SUBBARCODE!='000000000000'

select sh.CANCERTYPE,sh.PATHOLOGICALTYPE,sr.SUBBARCODE,sh.ERPSALERNAME,sh.AGE, sh.BARCODE,sh.ENTERDATE,sh.GETSPECDATE,sh.REPORTRECEIVER, sh.PATIENTNAME,sh.SEX,sh.BIRTHDAY,sh.CLINICALREMARK, sh.CUSTOMERNAME,sh.COLLECTDATE,sh.SPECIMENNUM,sh.UNIT,sh.SAMPLETYPE SHSAMPLETYPE, sh.CLINICALSTAGES, sh.DOCTORNAME, sh.LOCATIONNAME, sr.SAMPLETYPE SRSAMPLETYPE,sr.SAMPLENUM,sr.SAMPLEUNIT,sh.ERPTESTNAME,dep.LIBRARYNAME,area.FASTCODE,oper.OPERATEDATE, sh.SAMPLESOURCE,sh.FROMORGAN,sh.GENETYPE,sh.GENERESULT,sh.BIRTHPLACE,sh.FAMILYHISTORY,sh.SENDDATE,sh.IDNUM from SPECIMENHEAD sh left join SPECIMENHEADDETAIL smd on sh.BARCODE=smd.BARCODE left join SPECIMENRESULT sr on sr.SUBBARCODE =smd.SUBBARCODE left join DICTUSER us on sh.ENTERBY = us.DICTUSERID left join DICTLIBRARY dep on us.DICTDEPARTMENTID = dep.DICTLIBRARYID left join DICTLIBRARY area on us.USERCODE = area.ENGLIBRARYNAME left join OPERATIONLOG oper on sh.BARCODE=oper.BARCODE and oper.OPERATIONTYPE='节点-样本报告-报告上传' where sr.SUBBARCODE=#{subbarcode}

select sh.CANCERTYPE,sh.PATHOLOGICALTYPE,sr.SUBBARCODE,sh.ERPSALERNAME,sh.age, sh.BARCODE,sh.ENTERDATE,sh.GETSPECDATE,sh.REPORTRECEIVER, sh.PATIENTNAME,sh.SEX,sh.BIRTHDAY,sh.CLINICALREMARK, sh.CUSTOMERNAME,sh.COLLECTDATE,sh.SPECIMENNUM,sh.UNIT,sh.SAMPLETYPE SHSAMPLETYPE, sr.SAMPLETYPE SRSAMPLETYPE,sr.SAMPLENUM,sr.SAMPLEUNIT,sh.ERPTESTNAME, sh.SAMPLESOURCE,sh.FROMORGAN,sh.GENETYPE,sh.GENERESULT,sh.BIRTHPLACE,sh.FAMILYHISTORY,sh.SENDDATE,sh.IDNUM from SPECIMENHEAD sh left join SPECIMENHEADDETAIL smd on sh.BARCODE=smd.BARCODE left join SPECIMENRESULT sr on sr.SUBBARCODE =smd.SUBBARCODE where sh.BARCODE=#{barcode}
